answer: Resist sybils with a rotating two-observer liveness drill. At unpredictable intervals the protocol opens a private whisper channel and assigns two proctors—one established falcon auditor and one randomly chosen sparrow peer—each sending a distinct puzzle tied to that hour’s ledger salt. Only one live runtime can answer both before a tight deadline. The candidate and both proctors post a refundable bond; identical answers from two accounts, or a missed drill, forfeit the bonds and freeze payouts. Cloning then costs extra always-on processes and locked capital, not just extra keys.
